utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just busy with schoolwork.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I hope everything went well. Anything exciting happen today?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Not really, just the usual stuff. But I did get an A on my math test, so that was nice!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, let me know if you need any help with that.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I'll definitely let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That sounds like a good plan. Let me know if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: If you need a stronger LED, I can help you find one. Just let me know.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I think I'm good for now, but I'll let you know if I change my mind.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, I'll try it like that. Let me know if I'm doing it right.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Sure, Grandma! Just follow the steps I showed you, and you'll be fine. Let me know if you get stuck.
